# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old by the end of Volume 3  <sub>[v1 c3 P29](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0029), [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 c7 P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 c8 P1](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c7 P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c8 P1](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0001)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v2 c7 P0](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0000), [v2 c7 P20](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0020), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is a fair-haired child with smooth, neat, long curls and gentle, mild hazel eyes. She has a straight nose and a small mouth set in a demure, neat expression. She is known for her starched, neat, and immaculate appearance.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P20](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0020), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Lucy is quiet, well-behaved, polite, and obedient, behaving with great decorum. She is tidy, dependable, and reliable in completing household chores. Although she is gentle and easily intimidated by her brother Robin, she can be firm about proper conduct and religion. However, she sometimes yields to pressure when threatened with embarrassment.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P20](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0020), [v2 c7 P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013), [v2 c8 P16](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0016), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c19 P11](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0011), [v3 c13 P1](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0001), [v3 c13 P26](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0026)_

## Goals

- To marry Cedric Stanhope when she grows up  <sub>[v2 c19 P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020)</sub>

## History

After her mother's death, Lucy and her twin brother Robin were taken in by Thirza Abernethy at Grey Shutters in Brierley. She adapted easily to her new home, helping with chores and keeping her clothes clean, in contrast to her twin. On one occasion, Robin tricked her into walking on a pigpen fence, causing her to fall in and ruin her clothes, after which he sprayed her with a hose to clean her. In September, she began attending Brierley School alongside Robin. Following the death of her uncle in British Columbia, money was left in trust for her and Robin, securing her future at Grey Shutters. Later, while playing, she accidentally fell down the exterior cellar stairs, stripping the skin off her nose, but recovered quickly.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P0](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0000), [v2 c7 P20](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0020), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P46](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0046), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P12](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0012), [v3 c1 P33](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0033)_
